body:
We locked an initial product shape from your engineering brief (demand meeting).

Structured outcome:
{
  "ceo_summary": "We will enhance our CI pipeline robustness by deploying a minimal, highly observable API service to ensure faster, more reliable smoke test verification.",
  "constraints": [
    "• Implement a minimal HTTP echo server endpoint.",
    "• Integrate structured logging (e.g., JSON format) for all verification events.",
    "• Ensure the service is lightweight and has minimal overhead.",
    "• Define clear API contracts for CI consumers.",
    "• Ensure robust error handling within the server logic."
  ],
  "cpo_summary": "The product shape will be a minimal API service focusing purely on echo functionality and structured logging to ensure rapid feasibility and low maintenance overhead.",
  "modality": "api_service",
  "rationale": "An API service is the most suitable modality as it allows the creation of a lightweight, decoupled HTTP echo server that can be easily integrated into a CI pipeline for verification, fulfilling the requirement for a headless service."
}

---
Questions for you (reply via Staff Mail in the IDE when you are at the console):
· Does the chosen modality match how you imagine shipping this?
· Any hard UX/product constraints we should treat as non-negotiable?
· What success looks like for v1 (one sentence)?
subject: Design checkpoint — product modality & constraints
